CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Dim dbsReport As Database
Dim rstReport As Recordset

Private Sub Report_Close()
DoCmd.Restore
End Sub

Private Sub Report_Open(Cancel As Integer)
   '  Create underlying recordset for report using criteria entered in
   '  TransactionsDialogBox form.
   
   Dim intX As Integer
   Dim qdf As QueryDef
   
   '  Don't open report if TransactionDialogBox form isn't loaded
   If Not (IsLoaded("TransactionsDialogBox")) Then
      Cancel = True
      MsgBox "To Preview or print this report, you must open " _
         & "the Transactions Dialog Box in Form view.", 48, _
         "Must Open Dialog Box"
      Exit Sub
   End If
   
   Set dbsReport = CurrentDb()
   Set qdf = dbsReport.QueryDefs("Transactionsquery")
   
   '   Set parameters for query based on values entered
   '   in TransactionsDialogBox form.
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!BeginningDate") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!BeginningDate
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!EndingDate") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!EndingDate
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code1") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code1
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code2") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code2
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code3") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code3
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code4") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code4
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code5") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code5
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code6") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code6
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code7") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code7
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code8") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code8
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code9") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code9
   qdf.Parameters("Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code10") _
      = Forms!TransactionsDialogBox!Code10
      
   Set rstReport = qdf.OpenRecordset()
   
End Sub
